grammatica.evidence: Textbook multi-clause process sentences; technical appositives (e.g. 'NADPH, which carries high-energy electrons'); no coinages; standard science-expository register throughout.

dialectica.evidence: Stock causal chain: photon→excited e−→ETC→H+ gradient→ATP synthase; ATP/NADPH power Calvin; C4 concentrates CO2 near RuBisCO; low yield from slow RuBisCO, excess light, stomatal tradeoff.

rhetorica.evidence: Chooses classic teaching set and order: eq→chloroplast/chlorophyll→light reactions→Calvin/RuBisCO→food chains/GOE/fossil fuels→C3/C4/CAM→~1% efficiency/breeding; frames for essential-mechanism pedagogy.

arithmetica.evidence: Look-uppable claims: 6CO2+6H2O+light→C6H12O6+6O2; thylakoid/chlorophyll red-blue; photolysis, NADPH, RuBP/RuBisCO, 6 turns→glucose; O2~21%, GOE; C3/C4/CAM; ~half marine O2; ~1% crop efficiency.

geometria.evidence: Six untitled continuous paragraphs, one topical block each (definition, organelle, light stage, Calvin, stakes, variants, efficiency split across last two); no headings, lists, or figures.

musica.evidence: Even textbook cadence: long process sentences paced by commas/and; mild parallelisms ('from the air… from the soil… from above'); appositive definitions slow the beat for terms.

astronomia.evidence: Standard expand-out arc: definition+equation → locus/pigment → light stage → Calvin → planetary stakes → pathway diversity → efficiency ceiling/local optimum; intensity fairly level.

notes: Pure textbook restatement of public photosynthesis content; only Rhetorica rises above Stock as curatorial selection of a conventional teaching outline.
